summary: setup.py base64-obfuscated dropper fetches and executes remote Windows binary from Discord CDN at install
details: setup.py contains a base64-encoded payload passed to exec() via a lambda wrapper. At `pip install` time the decoded payload writes a PowerShell script to %TEMP%\python-stdlib-collection.ps1, uses Invoke-WebRequest to download a Windows.exe from a Discord CDN attachment URL (cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/...enlisted_launcher_1.0.3.190-movn8hpfe.exe), and launches it via `powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden` under CREATE_NO_WINDOW. The payload is guarded by a MY_SETUP_RUN environment variable to fire once and also invokes `os.system("calc")`. The staging filename `python-stdlib-collection.ps1` is a cover-story name; the fetched binary is unpinned, unverified, and hosted on an anonymous file-sharing CDN unrelated to any legitimate Python package publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
